name: replace-units-rings-farm
description: Replace Units footman -> farm beside other buildings' no-build (blue) rings than replace-units-overlap's barracks, gold mine and farm: an altar (10x10Simple), a town hall (16x16Simple), a tree of life (12x12TreeOfLife) and a necropolis (UndeadNecropolis, a ring 4 cells wide west and east) whose ring the farm reaches 16 into (r1 to r4), and a necropolis and a town hall whose rings it misses by 16 (r5, r6, the controls). Input tests/fixtures/we-compare/make-replace-units-rings-input.mjs; the editor's steps are replace-units-overlap-farm's

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.units?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
